headline: The cross-ticker read stays constructive overall, but today still looks selective rather than a broad clean risk-on continuation.

today.thesis: Friday's selloff looks more like a sector-wide de-risking than an NVDA-specific break, and the modestly green premarket plus peer bounce supports stabilization. But Mytutopia VEL5 -1.2 says the prior breakout impulse has cooled, so the most likely path is a choppy earnings-week rebound / consolidation rather than a clean trend day.

30d.thesis: - Direction: up - Confidence: 58/100 - Expected price range: $210.00-$280.00 - Range basis: regular-session close anchor; widened for earnings-event risk and high beta. - Brief thesis: The 30-day base case is still bullish because the current official setup — Blackwell scale, Rubin visibility, networking attach, and enterprise-agent / RL-infrastructure expansion — remains intact. Mytutopia's cooler RSI 64.7 is actually helpful because it reduces immediate overheating, but the slight negative VEL5 says not to use a narrow post-earnings range. - Key drivers: Q1 beat/guide vs ~$79B consensus; Data Center and networking commentary; gross-margin durability; any change in China assumptions; post-earnings sell-side target revisions. - Falsifiers: weaker-than-expected Q1 or guide; gross-margin slippage from mix/ramp; signs hyperscaler demand is financing-driven instead of end-demand-driven; worsening export-control language.

1y.thesis: - Direction: up - Confidence: 65/100 - Expected price range: $200.00-$410.00 - Range basis: regular-session close anchor; very wide because path risk is high even if the structural thesis remains favorable. - Brief thesis: The long-duration thesis is still that NVIDIA sits at the control point of AI infrastructure: accelerators, systems, networking, CUDA, and increasingly software/runtime orchestration. Today's Mytutopia readings matter only at the margin here; the more important question is whether the company can keep converting massive ecosystem relevance into durable earnings power without the broader AI capex cycle hitting an ROI wall. - Key drivers: sustained >50% revenue growth; Blackwell-to-Rubin transition; continued hyperscaler and sovereign demand; capital-allocation flexibility from huge cash generation; software/platform monetization. - Falsifiers: structural gross-margin erosion; materially weaker AI capex ROI across customers; successful hyperscaler/custom-silicon substitution; major regulatory/export deterioration.

cards.unusual_signal: Mytutopia cooled hard in one bar. The most interesting technical change since the last run is the shift from RSI 76.7 / VEL5 +13.3 (05-14) to RSI 64.7 / VEL5 -1.2 (05-15). That is not a broken chart, but it is a very clear message that the runaway pre-earnings impulse ended and the setup is now less one-sided.
cards.top_catalyst: The main event is still May 20 Q1 FY2027 earnings. Google Finance continues to show the call in 2 days, with consensus near $1.77-$1.78 EPS and roughly $78.8B-$79.1B revenue.
cards.top_risk: The balance sheet remains an enabler, not the new catalyst: yfinance still shows about $62.6B cash and about $58.1B free cash flow.
